protocolSource: Describe the dated protocol, preregistration, IRB document, or other source fixed before model fitting.

outcome.name: Define one exact future outcome
outcome.caseDefinition: Provide an operational case definition that a reviewer could reproduce without seeing model predictions.
outcome.adjudication: Describe who or what determines outcome status, the surveillance source, and how ambiguous cases are resolved.

population.description: Exact population description; this string must match the strict training command.

predictionIndex.definition: Exact prediction index definition; this string must match the strict training command.
predictionIndex.predictorCutoffRule: Only measurements available at or before the index time may be used.

cameraEvidenceScope.measurementDefinition: Versioned 2D projection measurement from the supported webcam/pose protocol; not a 3D joint-angle measurement.
supportedOutcomeContexts: List only research contexts actually supported by cited evidence and the planned cohort.
